label: TP
reason: Both alerts are valid. Alert 1 (java/xss): User input flows from request parameter names through the while loop into param, then through switch(case 'C') into bar, finally into response.getWriter().format() which can render user-controlled content as XSS. Alert 2 (tainted-format-string): Same flow - param (derived from user-supplied parameter names) reaches the format() call at line 83, allowing attackers to inject format specifiers. The switch target is hardcoded ('C'), making case 'C' reachable, so user input reaches the sink.

evidence.note: User parameter names flow through while loop into param, switch(target='C') assigns param to bar, bar written to format() sink at L83
Same data flow applies - tainted format string vulnerability confirmed
